name: Dev Tools
description: First-party developer diagnostics module. Loaded only when P2CLAW_DEV_MODE=true. Exposes debug_list_tools / debug_inspect_module / debug_tail_audit / debug_call_tool for LLM-side introspection of the tool framework. See DESIGN.md §4.7.

tools.name: debug_list_tools
tools.description: Lists every registered tool with its description, parameter schema, owner module id, required permissions, and effective risk. Read-only.

tools.name: debug_inspect_module
tools.description: Returns a snapshot of a loaded module by reverse-DNS id: declared permissions, runtime, firstParty flag, and per-tool requires. Read-only.

tools.name: debug_tail_audit
tools.description: Tails the last N entries from the active audit log (as raw JSONL). N defaults to 20 and is capped at 200. Read-only.

n.description: Number of most-recent lines to return. Default 20, max 200.

tools.name: debug_call_tool
tools.description: Force-invokes a target tool through the normal registry path with the given args. Every broker gate still fires; high-risk targets still require TOTP. Rejects self-recursion and nested debug calls. Returns the raw target result plus target metadata.

target.description: Name of the target tool to invoke.

args.description: Structured argument object passed to the target tool.
